Detailed Definition: Define Dirty Surplus as annual change in marketable securities adjustment msa plus annual change in retained earnings adjustment (recta) + .65 times the annual change in min(Unrecognized prior service cost (pcupsu) - Pension additional minimum liability (paddml),0). Real dirty surplus is the annual change in book equity (ceq) minus dirty surplus minus (net income (ni) minus dividends preferred (dvp)) + dividends (divamt) - end-of-fiscal-year-stock-price (prcc\_f)*annual change in common shares outstanding (csho).
